methodology.matching_universe: All already tracked completed alert episodes for the candidate city, independent of due/immediate/follow-up state.
methodology.publication_time_role: Used only to construct temporal candidate alert-window set; never treated as proof of explosion event time.
methodology.publication_window_rule: alert_start <= published_at <= alert_end + 30 minutes, unchanged from the former temporal candidate rule.
methodology.same_window_representation_rule: Two raw episode records are reconciled into one logical window only when both start and end boundaries differ by <=90 seconds. This mirrors the QA near90 diagnostic and is deliberately narrower than generic overlap union.
methodology.ambiguity_rule: After representation reconciliation, more than one logical window remains ambiguous; no arbitrary raw episode winner is selected.
methodology.status_rule: Matching is diagnostic/identity only in this step and never changes candidate status.
